note: Feedback's Planned and Recently shipped (plan 2 M8.7 block 2, Mako 2026-11-07). Kept by hand at every block that ships something a player would notice and at every milestone close-out (records: RULE -- keep the feedback page's Planned and Recently shipped current). Each line is a short title (t, a few words, what the page shows) and its detail (d, a sentence, shown on a tap). page is a RAVI_PAGES id, or app for the whole app. A version field (v) joins each update once testers start.

planned.d: Pick any area, not only Vancouver Island.
The app opens and works with no connection.
Ask a rules question in plain words and get an answer from Riot's own rules.
Install it from the store as well as from the web.
One plain page on what RAVI keeps and the terms of using it.

items.d: Each finish now shows its chance of making the cut, a percent beside the worst case, in place of Likely.
The Guide's Getting around can show you round the bar and any page: it lights one control at a time and says what it does. It never starts by itself.
At most once a day, an alert names each Wishlist card whose price moved 10% or more, down or up.
An alert when a store or area you follow adds an event. Alerts that land overnight wait until 9 AM.

New match has a Format: 1v1 as always, 2v2, 3 players or 4 players. Two seats on each long side of the table, each with its own score, Conquer, Hold and Pass turn; 2v2 plays to 11 as a team, free-for-all to 8.

Every island store that runs Riftbound, each alike, by town: where it is with directions, its next events, and its latest posts from News. Tap a store's name on Events or Store details on a Local post to get there.

Every card in one place: search by name or text, then see a card's text, every printing with its price and 7-day move, whether it is legal, and the rulings that name it. Add it to a deck, a binder or your Wishlist.
Like a shared deck from its page, see how many like each deck on Public, sort by likes, and find the ones you liked under Liked. Only the count is shown, never who.
News now has a Local kind: a short summary of what the island's stores post about Riftbound, every store alike, with the way to the post itself.
Events now lists Nanaimo, Duncan, Port Alberni and every other island town with a store. Events settings lets you turn each area on or off, and setup asks for your areas.
A night a store posts on its own page but not on PlayRiftbound now shows on Events, marked Not on PlayRiftbound, with a link to the post.
The page that prices a trade is named Appraise, so it reads apart from Exchange, where you find people to trade with.
A post's whole headline shows in its menu, a story Riot posted twice is one post, and Rules and Event posts wear their pages' colours.

items.t: Tier list search shows only matches
items.d: Tiers with no match fold away while you search.
Add a deck now offers a way to Decks when you have none.
Every page has its own colour, grouped by Riftbound's runes, and the domains glow brighter.
Go to lists pages in six groups: playing, competitive, trading, your cards, learning, and about the app.
Game is now Tracker, New here is now Guide, and Trade board is now Exchange.
Your colour, the Tracker's sides and Trade's sides use new colours that match the app's palette.
Pages and decks zoom open from what you tap, menus grow from their button, and rows unfold in place.

items.t: Pages show their shape while loading
items.d: While a page waits for its data, it shows grey blocks in its own layout instead of a loading line.
Any page you reach from another page has Back, and it walks back along your path.

items.t: Card reveals and more of Riot's posts
items.d: Riot's card reveals, and its posts on Instagram and YouTube, now come to News.
Riot's drawings stay at the top of News while entries are open, and come back on drawing day to remind you to check your email.
Riot's posts in plain words, each with a headline and a short summary, read without leaving the app.
Planned and Recently shipped on this page.

items.t: Sort and Filters in card search
items.d: Sort and Filters when you search for cards.
Movers as a grid, and Sort and Filters in the card browser.
A new icon set and refined page colours across the app.
Player colours from the app's palette.
Tap a card's picture in any menu to see it full size.
A first-time setup, and How to play with Riot's own cards and symbols.
App settings laid out like the iPhone's own Settings.
Live open play and learn-to-play events, and a warning before you follow a calendar twice.
Who near you has the cards you want, and who wants yours, with offers and reports.
Each legend's top-cut decklists and most-played cards.
Folders and tags, popular lists per legend, and a deck image to share.
Event times fixed after the clocks changed.
Accounts with passkeys: your decks, collection and matches on every device, with a profile and your Riot ID.
Legends ranked by top cuts, worldwide or local, with the decks behind them.
Rounds and the cut read from the event.
Live event data: your pairing, the round clock and alerts when the next round is posted.
RAVI moved to ravi.tools.
A place to start for new players.
What record makes the cut.
Pick the blocks on your hub.
Your cards and what they are worth over time.
Build, import and share decks.
Follow a store's events in your calendar app.
Riot's rules, errata and FAQs, word for word.
Events from PlayRiftbound, and the Pre-Rift event type.
